Hi Sarah — thanks, glad to hear ClearSky is moving forward. Below is the usual checklist for marketplace vendor onboarding + procurement. I attached our forms and a PO template for your team.

Quick checklist (high level)
- Vendor legal name + registered address (exact as on tax docs)
- Tax information: W‑9 (US) or W‑8 / VAT details (non-US)
- Bank wire / ACH details for payouts (for marketplace flows this is handled via the marketplace)
- DUNS or SAM registration (for some customers, optional for marketplace listing)
- Primary billing contact and invoice email
- Completed security questionnaire (required for Dedicated/Private deals)
- Pricing and SKU/plan definitions for marketplace listing

What we can do on our side
- If you choose AWS Marketplace listing, Redwood can support both marketplace-managed billing and direct invoicing for the first 1–3 months while the listing is finalized.
- We’ll need an executed SaaS agreement (DocuSign) if billing direct; marketplaces sometimes require a separate marketplace listing agreement.

Attachments (stubs):
- onboarding_form_v2.pdf (vendor onboarding checklist/form)
- po_template.xlsx (Redwood PO template for finance)
- security_questionnaire.xlsx (baseline security questionnaire)

Next steps
1) If you can send W‑9 + vendor legal name, we’ll start supplier setup with Finance.
2) If you prefer marketplace billing, reply and we’ll share marketplace ops contact and listing requirements.
3) I’ll loop in our procurement and legal to advise on contract/PO flow — cc'd Laura to help.

Would you like a 30-min call this week to go over?

Thanks,

Thanks for the ping. Procurement checklist & timing below — note these are our standard requirements to get a supplier live in our ERP and to issue POs if needed.

Procurement / Finance requirements (US vendor)
- Completed and signed W‑9 (ClearSky needs to return this)
- Vendor legal name exactly as registered; EIN (or VAT for non-US)
- Bank/ACH remit details (for vendor payments) or marketplace payout confirmation if using AWS Marketplace
- Contact person for invoicing and billing email
- Completed supplier onboarding form (I attached our internal supplier packet template if needed)

Timeline estimates
- Vendor setup in ERP: 3–5 business days after we receive W‑9 + bank details and vendor packet.
- PO creation: same day we have supplier in ERP, assuming no special approval needed.
- Marketplace listing coordination: separate process — depends on marketplace (AWS listing review ~2–4 weeks typically).

Other notes
- For AWS Marketplace-managed billing: Finance needs confirmation of marketplace account id and whether Redwood or the customer will be the bill-to party. If billing is marketplace-managed and Redwood isn't invoicing directly, a PO may not be necessary for the initial purchase, but some enterprise customers still require a PO to reconcile.
- For direct invoicing: we will need a signed SaaS order form. Drafts can go through Legal — Jordan, can you say if we need any special clauses for marketplace origin transactions?

I can start vendor record creation as soon as we have the W‑9 and vendor legal name. I'll also attach our vendor_packet_template.docx.
